dedupe_keys.name: centraline semaforiche flussi di traffico giornalieri

description: Centraline semaforiche - Flussi di traffico giornalieri is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Puglia. Flussi di traffico giornalieri ovvero numero di mezzi in transito rilevati dalle centraline semaforiche (dataset al link Ciascuna centralina è dotata di uno o più sensori (detector) identificati con la quadrupla (devicedb, devicetype, deviceid, detectorid) Le risorse sono raggruppate per mese di rilevamento. Coverage: Regione Puglia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Puglia. Its tags are strada, traffico. It offers 11 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
